key_insight: PlenopticDreamer synchronizes generative hallucinations across views and time so camera-controlled re-renderings remain spatially and temporally coherent in multi-view settings.
problem_solved: Eliminates inconsistent or flickering hallucinated content when re-rendering videos from multiple camera viewpoints, a common failure of single-view generative re-renderers.
method: Synchronize latent hallucinations across camera views and adjacent frames to lock generated details in space and time.
Condition the generator on camera parameters and multi-view alignment cues to preserve cross-view geometry.
Enforce spatio-temporal consistency during training with losses and alignment mechanisms that penalize view/temporal mismatch.
impact: Enables reliable, camera-controlled multi-view video re-rendering with stable hallucinations—benefitting tasks like multi-camera editing, VR/AR content creation, and synthetic dataset generation where cross-view consistency is critical.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing input multi-view video + camera poses → latent synchronization module → consistent re-rendered views
Before/after comparison: inconsistent hallucinations (flicker/mismatch) vs. synchronized, coherent outputs
Camera rig / multi-view schematic illustrating cross-view alignment and shared hallucination space
Temporal stability chart or frame-difference heatmap highlighting reduced flicker over time
paper_authors: Xiao Fu, Shitao Tang, Min Shi, Xian Liu, Jinwei Gu
